description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 so it cannot be opened without the password. Only AES-256 is offered — 40-bit and 128-bit are classed as weak crypto. The password is used locally and never transmitted; it also cannot be recovered, so it must be stored somewhere safe. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists

noCopy.description: Disallow text/graphic extraction (accessibility extraction stays permitted)

noPrint.description: Disallow printing (enforced by the reader, not the encryption)

output.description: Path to write the protected PDF

password.description: Password required to open the document

name: pdf_protect
title: Password-protect a PDF
